# Housekeeping: capi

## Authorized scope and smallest closable slice

Review the complete `crates/capi` Cargo package and its tests. Deliver practical, behavior-preserving cleanup in this package, or an evidenced no-change verdict when existing choices earn their cost. Cover all five user requests: repeated code/LoC; load-bearing test purposes; avoidable copies; applicable micro SIMD; and data structures that cap efficiency. The user requests two GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh agents concurrently; this overrides the default Terra implementation model for this workflow. Root Sol owns briefing, adversarial review, exact-path checkpoints, integration and remote synchronization.

## Frozen boundaries

Existing public APIs, feature behavior, canonical/wire identities, arithmetic order and per-lane rendered bits, latency/tail, link modes, smoothing and NaN/denormal rules remain contractual. Zero render allocations/frees, locks, I/O or syscalls; no runtime native ISA dispatch. Retain scalar tails, 4-lane Wasm/NEON and x86 AVX2/FMA. Preserve all feature and target configurations. Do not expand another open issue or change DSP algorithms. Read current related issue bodies before touching their subject; discoveries that require architecture or product decisions become bounded follow-ups and final owner questions.

## Implementation and test-value decisions

Prefer deleting or consolidating repetition to adding abstractions that increase total complexity. Assess every existing test or a clearly named homogeneous family by its plausible unique defect; remove trivial, redundant or obsolete cases only after identifying the surviving behavioral gate. Keep independent numeric/oracle, fault, allocation, queue, boundary and target tests. Add/rewrite tests only for a concrete uncovered defect, and state which plausible defect no existing test catches. No prose/source-grep tests, new bit-digest pins or exact resource-byte pins. Copies needed for ownership, snapshots or atomic admission stay unless the same semantics are proved with less work. Data structure changes must preserve deterministic order and bounded realtime work. Inspect applicable hot loops and generated code before claiming additional SIMD; recursive/stateful dependencies alone do not justify changing arithmetic.

## Objective gates and evidence

- Read all production and test files in this package; record concise findings for each of the five requests, concrete changed/deferred locations, and load-bearing test families with retained coverage for deletions.
- Run focused locked package tests and affected feature configurations; use existing downstream/RT/differential gates proportional to the changed contract. Check formatting and package clippy with warnings denied. Relevant Wasm and AArch64 compile checks are required for changed product code; record limitations candidly.
- Changes to DSP arithmetic or hot state need existing independent numeric and scalar/SIMD gates plus one-time base/head evidence when needed; no permanent comparison against the old implementation. Existing research remains the algorithm authority; no new algorithm or listening claim is authorized.
- Benchmarks are optional and descriptive. Any timed measurement freezes its workload/validator, passes zero-workload preflight, and runs exactly one invocation with one warmup/two measured rounds. No timing optimization loop, performance percentage or unsupported sound-quality claim.
- Root conducts one adversarial verdict per coherent attempt, at most five total attempts. Every new/rewritten test gets its unique-defect sentence in that verdict. No-change audits require the same five-axis review, not manufactured edits.
- Stop after a coherent compiling, focused-green tranche; root commits exact owned paths before further edits. Keep edits within `crates/capi` and this numbered spec. Independent crates use separate worktrees. Root pushes promptly and updates this GitHub issue with evidence; close only after PASS and evidence upstream, verifying remote state. Merge through the required qualification check and remove clean completed worktrees.

## Sol brief approval and decision record

Approved 2026-10-01 by root Sol within the user's crate-by-crate housekeeping request. Attempt 1 is authorized with the frozen scope/gates above. Owner questions are collected for the final report; routine reversible cleanup proceeds autonomously. Scope is this package's housekeeping, not completion of pre-existing feature/bug issues.

## Attempt evidence

### Attempt 1 — complete bounded package audit and implementation

Worker B (requested GPT-6.1 Sol xhigh) read every package file: nine Rust implementation/test modules, the retained-allocation integration test, Cargo manifest, checked-in C header and both C/C++ consumers; there is no package build script or additional support file. Related current scopes reviewed include #349/#559/#560, #1020, #1053/#1057/#1058, #1074/#1079, #1008 and canonical JSON #338. Baseline and changed default tests both passed 35 unit + nine integration tests, zero doctests/ignores. Root checkpoint `daba46e1` was integrated/pushed through `93469867`; product edits stopped at focused green. Rust change: 42 insertions/90 deletions, net **−48 lines**, no test function added or retired, no dependency/header/ABI/feature change.

**Five requested axes.** Repetition: `last_error` classifies the common immutable header once, retains engine/session/plan branch order and rejects an unrecognized live header before bytes-output validation. Plan access still projects only the atomic diagnostic field; null inputs remain the earliest refusal. `prepared_capi_resources` no longer returns the source-ID byte sum that its sole caller discarded; the checked sum and resource/error order are unchanged. Tests reuse the existing `empty_report` initializer with the same hostile reserved sentinel and read one Copy report for the same pre-mutation assertions. Test value: all existing families below earn their cost; no same-run hash/private layout pin was found to retire. Copies: render-activity counter staging now reads configured IDs by reference and builds only the required owned `CounterValue` vector, preserving ID order, values and empty behavior before the mutable stage call. Source-plane/ring publication, replay bytes, owned diagnostics/catalogs, current/prospective models and epoch ownership copies stay because caller lifetimes or atomic refusal require them. SIMD: no sample arithmetic changed. `objdump` of the separately built shipping x86 release `libcapi.so` shows the current peak fold already uses AVX `vandps`/`vmaxps`, unordered comparisons/blends, horizontal reductions and four-word/scalar tails; the source's scalar loop is not proof of scalar machine execution. A new kernel or shared host peak service would overlap #559 IO8 and need explicit NaN/signed-zero equivalence. The changed header helper emits three prefix field loads and scalar comparisons without a header materialization/copy call; its `memcpy` branches copy the necessary caller output. Data structures: the fixed two-row report table and one-slot pending/retired provider vectors remain appropriate for the bounded exchange; their linear operations are bounded and control-only. Source-ID lookup already uses the facade's compact arena/ordered table. No extra index, architecture or timing result is claimed.

**Complete retained test families and unique purposes.** Setup-only rewrites preserve their original plausible defects; no coverage was traded for line reduction.

- ABI Rust size/alignment/offset and code/mask gates, C11 signature/layout/symbol/shared/static consumers and C++17 standard-layout/header compile defend the exported ABI/wire contract. These exact pins are intentional public format owners.

- `compile_publishes_both_children_and_source_control_is_region_checked` keeps both independent children, report reserved-data refusal/no-write, source region/generation/final-marker behavior, render refusal/no-write/continuity and command/event query/retry through raw exports. Reusing `empty_report` retains every sentinel/assertion and uniquely catches publishing only one child or forwarding a malformed source/output descriptor.
- Compile diagnostic query/retry/handle-local state, the empty-object abort regression and all four refused extended rates preserve strict JSON/UTF-8 diagnostics, cleared child outputs, full-copy refusal and launch-rate boundaries; source diagnostics cover seven submission rules, seek rules and accepted-call clearing.
- Render diagnostic cases, pure resource-query diagnostic preservation, oversized dangling lengths and misaligned plane/output cases defend rule-specific errors, pre-read validation and untouched PCM/metadata. The plan-query concurrent test retains a provenance-carrying pointer, 2,000 render blocks (16 under Miri) and real concurrent immutable/atomic queries.
- `generated_session_prepares_independent_source_and_plan_ownership` retains all report claims, accepted submission, inclusive end seek and zero-frame final marker; capturing its report once precedes all mutations. Ring-zero/default-vs-explicit preparation separately catches wrapper default derivation/accounting drift.
- Structural atomic epochs/source reset/replay test, plan-first destruction, all six phases × six ordered second faults and exported replay/revision/event/publication pressure test defend no ack before a drop, untouched canonical/model/replay/queues/resources/PCM on refusal, exact owner/credit disposal and retry progress. Owner counts are claims; wire response/event pins describe the stable protocol.
- Three deterministic swap-window owners separately cover ordinary control calls before epoch publication, tight effect-state admission paired with the newest plan, and a rejected render that nevertheless swapped. Real control/render races with and without competing resource readers defend progress/report-row lifetime and measure zero render allocations/frees; they are not replaced by the split-render simulation.
- Every advertised command-family gate, all six event-family exact bytes and short/query/exact retry, replacement parameter catalog and rendered-clock tests preserve wire identities, routing, ordering/coalescing/loss, retained capacities, current handles and sample visibility. The counter event's current pinned bytes qualify the borrowed-ID staging change.
- Direct/C PCM parity retains one/ten tracks × four launch rates, signed zero, partial final chunks, generation seek, underrun/tail and both destroy orders; the two-thread source/render barrier owner adds real separated thread ownership and nonvacuous PCM. x86 FP cases retain the separate refusal diagnostic, hostile/canonical/unguarded subnormal differential, nonvacuity and exact caller-word restoration on success and early/late refusal.

No private historical byte literal replaces these observations. The compiled plan remains bounded by estimated engine rows rather than an exact retained walk: existing #1074 owns that documented slack.

No checker mutation or ABI file changed.

These are compile checks, not local ARM/Wasm execution or mobile linkage; native C layout/link/runtime evidence is x86-64 only. ## Root adversarial verdict: PASS — attempt 1

Root Sol inspected every changed product/test line against its original code and the complete package-family audit. The common immutable header still rejects null arguments first, distinguishes the same three live kinds in the same order and never borrows the plan's render-exclusive state; the counter snapshot finishes its owned-value collection before staging, preserving every configured ID and order. Resource arithmetic/refusal order and reserved-output sentinels remain unchanged. The default/release test, separate shipping-abort build, native ABI/link and compile-target logs were inspected; the shipping peak-fold disassembly supports existing vectorization, with no timing or cross-target execution claim. Existing #1074 completeness slack and #1008 Rust-test workaround remain explicitly bounded.

Rewritten-test purposes: `compile_publishes_both_children_and_source_control_is_region_checked` uniquely catches child publication/source-region or reserved-report refusal regressions through the raw exports, with the same hostile sentinel after initializer consolidation. `generated_session_prepares_independent_source_and_plan_ownership` uniquely catches incorrect child resource claims and independent source/plan lifetime behavior, with the same assertions now using one pre-mutation report. No new test was introduced or existing test retired. All five requested audit axes are covered; no owner decision is needed for this slice.
